title: Terminal
explain: A shell in a throwaway container that sees only this project's folder (read-only unless allowed, no network unless allowed). It ends when you leave or after 15 idle minutes. What you type is not recorded.
enabled: Allow a terminal on this project
writable: Allow writing to the project's files
network: Allow network access (the shell can then reach this node's internal network and the internet)
writableTip: Lets the shell change the project's files. Off, it can only read them.
networkTip: Gives the shell network access, so it can reach the internet and other containers.
openTip: Opens a shell in a throwaway container, in this project's folder
